description:
Role / tag pill with a tinted background derived from a hex colour.
When `color` is provided the chip uses a 15 % alpha fill and a
matching dot; when absent it falls back to a neutral muted style.

Optional `onRemove` renders a small ✕ button inside the pill.

props.name: color
props.description: Hex colour (`#RGB` or `#RRGGBB`) for the tinted background.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Callback when the remove button is clicked. Renders the ✕ when provided.

props.name: removeAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the remove button.

props.name: removeDisabled
props.description: Disables the remove button without hiding it.
